1.explanation: This minimal React app uses @carbon/react v11 and React 17. We create a ref with createRef() and pass it directly to the DatePicker component. Since DatePicker in v11 is not wrapped with React.forwardRef, React will emit the warning that function components cannot be given refs, and datePickerRef.current will be null/undefined at runtime. This reproduces the bug reported (the missing forwardRef wrapper in DatePicker).
1.bug_scenario: In v11 of @carbon/react the DatePicker component is implemented as a plain function component but does not wrap itself with React.forwardRef. When you attempt to pass a ref to DatePicker (for example, to programmatically focus or inspect its underlying input), React will warn “Function components cannot be given refs. Attempts to access this ref will fail. Did you mean to use React.forwardRef()?” and dpRef.current will be undefined.
